newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot natgas mostly higher with NYMEX rally.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot natgas mostly higher with NYMEX rally.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were steady to higher Tuesday, led by a rallying futures market and a tighter supply situation in the west, traders said.
Spot gas at Alberta's AECO storage hub was talked at C$1.48/1.49 per gigajoule, up one to two cents from Monday, while temperature highs in Calgary stretched into the mid-70s F.
At Sumas, Wash., prices remained steady at $1.19-1.20 per million British thermal units (mmBtu).

Westcoast Energy began a 20-day maintenance outage Sunday at its 350 million cubic feet per day (mmcfd) Pine River gas plant in British Columbia. The plant was expected to process about 175-180 mmcfd for most of the period, drop to zero August 27-28 and then return to about half capacity through the remainder of the outage.
At Niagara, prices climbed four cents to about $2.70 as NYMEX's September contract rallied to a high of $2.545, up 11.9 cents.
